name: Woodsmith of hilton head island
old_description: Our dining room table had a glass top and two columns that screamed “1990’s”. Because we had a custom-made area rug that we did not want to replace, we struggled with how to update the dining room set. We were so excited when we found Brian online. He was amazing to work with and the new pedestals matched our existing chairs perfectly. We are so pleased!
about:
Woodsmith of Hilton Head Island operates from a woodshop on Hilton Head Island, South Carolina. The business is run by Brian Meehan, a self-described woodsmith who designs and builds custom furniture and smaller wooden items. No founding year is publicly stated.

Meehan produces one-of-a-kind pieces including dining tables, benches, live-edge countertops, shelves, and specialty items such as a shot-glass display. Each project is custom designed and handcrafted from furniture-grade lumber selected for the job. Meehan works on only one client project at a time, so the project queue can stretch several months. There is no showroom; customers collaborate directly with him at the shop or remotely.

The client base is primarily residential homeowners and rental-property owners on Hilton Head Island and the surrounding area. Testimonials describe dining-room updates, a bourbon-room countertop, and a custom display for a shot-glass collection.

Meehan emphasizes that quality craftsmanship requires time and diligence, and that every piece is an original born from a shared vision with the customer. He devotes his full attention to each build, rarely overlapping projects.
